desc: I'm a final-year Computer Science student at the University of Technology Sarawak, focused on building AI-powered applications that solve real problems. My final year project is a real-time Malaysian Sign Language recognition system using a CNN-LSTM model, which placed Top 5 in my faculty and won Silver at International Invention, Innovation & Design Competition (INDES) 2026. Before moving into AI, I built mobile and web apps end to end with Flutter, Firebase and ASP.NET Core, and I enjoy carrying an idea all the way from model to working product.

projects.title: Malaysian Sign Language Recognition
projects.description: A real-time recognition system trained on my own dataset, using MediaPipe Holistic for hand and body tracking and a fine-tuned CNN-LSTM model (82% average accuracy). The ASP.NET Core web version reaches 90.6% average accuracy and outputs English and Bahasa Melayu text, helping non-signers learn MSL.
